objective: Plan the Catnip game expansion: coin + milestone economy, store screen, power-up balls (explosive, multi-ball, magnet), cat abilities (dash, shield, clone), obstacles/bumpers, and four cosmetic systems (cat skin, ball skin, arena theme, artifact passive). File structure splits from single index.html into ES modules.

teammates.name: nightcrawler-recon
teammates.responsibility: Map index.html structure; identify modularization seams and tight coupling. Task #1.

teammates.name: sage-research
teammates.responsibility: Research localStorage economy patterns, Canvas skin rendering without assets, Web Audio for new SFX. Task #2.

teammates.name: forge-architecture
teammates.responsibility: Design multi-file architecture, data schemas (coin economy, store catalog, skins, artifacts), new GameState additions, power-up/ability/bumper systems. Task #3.

teammates.name: beast-review
teammates.responsibility: Gap-check the plan draft for missing acceptance criteria, edge cases, scope ambiguity, over-engineering. Task #5.
